sentences.text:
======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Ashwini Kumar Rai, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Ms. Sharda Kumari, A.P.P.
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Prabhat Kumar Singh
2 17-08-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.

2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 363,
376/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Prosecution case, in brief, is that on 05.11.2022 at about 8:00 pm, co-accused Mina Devi and Rajendra Prasad, who happen to be co-villagers of the informant, called her at their house and thereafter co-accused Rajendra Prasad along with four named accused including this petitioner came there by vehicle and forcibly took her to Buxar and committed rape upon her.
4. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that there is no eye witness of the occurrence.
Victim is a married lady and Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.50586 of 2023(2) dt.17-08-2023 this petitioner has been made accused only on suspicion.
5. Considering the nature and gravity of the offence, prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is refused.
